notes: §2002:14.8.36.2 SR13: a table SORT subject subject to more than one OCCURS level writes a subscript for every level, the rightmost the word ALL. At COBOL-2002 SORT E (2) over a nested table is refused COBOL7369 and SORT E (2, ALL) sorts row 2 (kb/Work PB5641); COBOL-2014 and later let the subject omit its own level (§2023:8.4.2.3.3 SR5 e).
